summary: CancunTargetingGasLimitCalculator correctly implements the EIP-4844 excess_blob_gas update rule and blob gas limits for its scope. computeExcessBlobGas matches calc_excess_blob_gas spec logic and currentBlobGasLimit/transaction cap correctly enforce MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK. Remaining EIP-4844 components (precompile, KZG validation, tx validation) are out-of-scope for this class and implemented elsewhere.
